command: set -e; python -c "import inspect, edullm_data, edullm_data.profiles.registry as R, edullm_data.publish as P; assert edullm_data.__version__=='0.9.1', 'WRONG IMAGE VERSION: '+edullm_data.__version__; assert 'hash_workers' in inspect.signature(P.publish).parameters, 'NO HASH WORKERS'; m=R.get_profile('pretrain-tokens/v1'); assert m.NAME=='pretrain-tokens/v1', m.NAME; s=inspect.getsource(P); assert 'source_kind == \"local\"' in s, 'DELETE GUARD MISSING -- staged shards at risk'; assert 'startswith(\"pretrain-tokens/\")' in s, 'PROFILE BRANCH MISSING'; print('PREFLIGHT_OK=6 version='+edullm_data.__version__+' profile='+m.NAME)"; python -c "import boto3; s=boto3.client('s3'); s.download_file('edullm-landing','_ingest/final-dataset/PUBLISH/publish_driver.py','/tmp/publish_driver.py'); s.download_file('edullm-landing','_ingest/final-dataset/corpus-registry.json','/tmp/corpus-registry.json'); print('FETCH_OK')"; cd /tmp && echo PUBLISH_START mode=${PUBLISH_MODE}; set +e; python /tmp/publish_driver.py ${PUBLISH_MODE}; RC=$?; echo PUBLISH_DONE_RC=${RC}; exit ${RC}
